classification.difficultyReason: Interpret the shaded region as outer rectangle minus inner rectangle, form both area products and solve the resulting linear equation.

content.prompt:
The area of the shaded region is $121\text{ cm}^2$.

Find the value of $x$.

spec.description: Outer rectangle with a central rectangular hole. Preserve all four outer right-angle markers and associate each dimension with its own boundary. Drawing coordinates express the source arrangement, not numerical dimensions.
spec.mathematics: Outer dimensions are 6x cm and 8 cm; inner dimensions are x cm and 4 cm. The shaded area is the outer area minus the inner area.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions and region identification are visible.

answer.short:
$x=2\frac{3}{4}$.

Subtract the inner rectangle's area from the outer rectangle's area.
answer.worked:
The shaded area equals the outer area minus the inner area.

$$\begin{align*}(6x)(8)-(x)(4)&=121\\48x-4x&=121\\44x&=121\\x&=\frac{121}{44}\\x&=2\frac{3}{4}\end{align*}$$
